root_cause.detail: The candidate placed runner.temp expressions in jobs.complete.env. GitHub Actions does not make the runner context available to jobs.<job_id>.env, so the workflow was rejected before a runner or any step existed.

bounded_correction: Move runner.temp-dependent staging/report variables from job-level env to step-level env where runner context exists.
Add a regression test that forbids runner context in the job-level env block.
Add the already-effective merge SHA to the existing idempotent post-merge recovery manifest.
Rerun repository and VIT/SIQ/GRT exact-final assurance on the correction candidate.
Squash-merge the bounded correction when eligible.
Use the corrected main-triggered workflow to process both the correction merge and the queued already-effective cutover merge without replaying either physical-main write.
rollback: If the bounded correction cannot pass, preserve the effective cutover merge and failure evidence, do not replay physical main, and stop with the remote completion path fail-closed.
